name: Defending an Area
description:
You block, guard, or otherwise impede entry, such as blocking a doorway or guarding a perimeter. Any creature attempting to enter your melee range must use an Action to make an opposed Body (Athletics) check against you; if you are wielding a shield, you have Advantage on this check.

If the creature fails, it cannot enter your melee range and its movement stops immediately. Allies can use the Help action to grant you +1 bonus die per ally aiding the defense.
